title: Raw JSON object without markdown code fences
rationale: Output parsers expect raw JSON; a fenced code block breaks single-pass parsing in CI gates and agent loops that do not strip Markdown.

prompt.content: You are a JSON-only API. Every reply must be raw JSON: no prose, no markdown, no code fences.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0; the demanded object is fixed. Extraction accepts a bare JSON value or one fenced block, which is why the negate unit for a triple-backtick fence is required: a model that wraps the object in a Markdown block passes the schema unit but fails the probe. Brittleness: extract_json scans forward to the first parseable JSON value, so a one-line preamble followed by bare JSON would still pass; the probe targets the common Markdown-fence failure.
